## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric mantra-text by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)), the second of his four-text Vaiśravaṇa state-protection cluster ([KR6j0475](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0475)–[KR6j0478](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0478), T1247–T1250). Where the preceding text [KR6j0475](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0475) is the full *yíguǐ* 儀軌 (ritual manual), this T1248 is the *zhēnyán* 真言 (mantra-only) abbreviated counterpart — the bare protective mantra together with the briefest instructions on its battlefield deployment.

**Abstract**

The text gives the **suíjūn hùfǎ zhēnyán** in transliterated Sanskrit, with brief notes on use: the mantra to be recited by ritual specialists accompanying the imperial armies on campaign, on behalf of the *huguó* 護國 ("state protection") programme that constituted Amoghavajra's chief institutional contribution to Tang Buddhism. As an abbreviated practitioner's manual it complements [KR6j0475](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0475) (T1247) and was likely intended for portable battlefield use. Date: Amoghavajra's Chángān activity, 746–774.
